metaTitle: Custom Flame Resistant Work Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom flame resistant work shirts for your team. Perfect for safety managers and bulk buyers. Shop at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Flame resistant work shirts are a critical layer of protection for workers in industrial environments where flash fire or arc flash hazards exist. Unlike standard cotton or poly-cotton blends, FR fabrics self-extinguish to reduce burn injury severity. Choose from button-front or henley styles in lightweight cotton blends that maintain breathability while meeting NFPA 70E or ASTM F1506 standards. Add your company logo or safety slogan with heat-applied transfers or embroidery that won't compromise the fabric's protective properties.
heroAltText: Custom flame resistant work shirts with embroidered logo for industrial safety uniforms
